$comment: Named test cases for snapshot.schema.json, as JSON Patches (RFC 6902) on `base`. Invalid cases name the JSON Schema keyword (`rule`) that must reject them. Tests: agent/tests/test_snapshot.py. In `base`, the window and all 14 element descriptors come from a real UI Automation capture of the trial app (#9, #11) and `capture.durationMs` is the measured median of six real snapshots of that window (28-32 ms, 2026-11-01, Windows 11, 125 % scaling); `snapshotId` and `capture.startedAt` are fixed by the test fixture so that the file is reproducible.

valid.name: a window whose title, class name and dpi could not be read
an elevated process, whose exe name and version are unreadable
the window alone, as a snapshot of a window with no children
a label the toolkit itself confirmed through LabeledBy
a window on a monitor left of and above the primary one
a walk with a smaller budget than the default, as the timeoutMs param sets
a walk in which some property reads failed

valid.$comment: A gap in the contract, not a wish: `minLength: 1` cannot say "not only spaces", so this document is schema-valid. The agent never writes one (`ayna_agent.model._blank`), but a Java or TypeScript producer could. Raised on the snapshot-schema-v0 ADR, because closing it changes element.schema.json too.
valid.name: a whitespace-only name, which the schema cannot refuse

invalid.name: a version this release does not speak
no snapshot id
a snapshot id that is not a string
an empty snapshot id
no capture block
a capture without its element count
a capture without its feature version
a feature version in upper case
a fractional duration
a budget of zero, which no walk can meet
a timestamp without a time zone
an unknown capture key
an exe path instead of its file name
a window without its handle
a handle of zero
the process name, which the app block carries instead
no elements at all
an element without its id
an element without a parentId key, which the root needs as null
a parentId that is a number
the tree links written inside the descriptor
the pattern probes of the #6 dump, which a snapshot does not read
an empty name, which is left out rather than stored
a localised control type
bounds with three numbers
fractional bounds
a dpi of zero
a negative sibling index
a label source that is not one of the three rules
a window handle of zero on an element
an unknown top-level key
